name: Search Tools
description: Discover and load enabled tools by task, plugin, or tool name.

function.name: search_tools
function.description: Search authorized tools and load matching schemas for the next model response. Use this before concluding a capability is unavailable. Search by task keywords, plugin name, or exact tool name. Use '*' and offset to browse. Wait for the result before calling a discovered tool. Reports total schema tokens and a soft context target; over_target never blocks necessary tools.
